name: Google Maps Platform API
description: Direct Google Maps Platform calls: Geocoding API and Places API (New) text search. API key from secret-guard (`pnpm kyberion secret introduce google-maps API_KEY`), sent as the `key` query parameter.
setup_hint: Create an API key with the Geocoding API and Places API (New) enabled, then run pnpm kyberion secret introduce google-maps API_KEY.

maps_search.description: Search places by free text (Places API New, places:searchText). Read-only: the request is a query.

maps_geocode.description: Geocode an address to coordinates (Geocoding API).
